character_tex: String functions: $\chi^{SU(2)_k}_l(\tau, z) = \sum_{m \in \mathbb{Z}_{2k}} \Phi^l_m(\tau)\,\frac{\Theta_{m,k}(\tau,z)}{\eta(\tau)}$ with $\Theta_{m,k} = \sum_{n\in\mathbb{Z}+m/2k} q^{kn^2}z^{kn}$, computed from the Weyl-Kac formula; fields $(l,m)\sim(k-l,m+k)$, $l \equiv m \pmod 2$, $h^l_m = \frac{l(l+2)}{4(k+2)} - \frac{m^2}{4k}$ for $|m| \le l$.
description: Diagonal invariant of the $\mathbb{Z}_{2}$ parafermion theory (Fateev-Zamolodchikov; Gepner-Qiu): 3 fields.
